## 1. Executive Summary

The comprehensive 4-Tier verification suite for the Nimbus weather platform has been implemented, validated, and verified with **100% clean test execution** (zero failures, zero regressions). The test suite exercises every module across backend ingestion pipelines, parallel statistical reductions, WebP texture encoding, Axum REST endpoints, WebGL GLSL shaders, 16-bit unpack math, GPU LRU cache bounding, and real-world complex workload scenarios.

## 4. Instructions for Running the Full Test Suite

### 4.1. Run Backend & Scenario Tests (Cargo)
To run all backend unit, integration, boundary, cross-feature, and scenario tests:
```bash
cargo test
```
To run specific test tiers individually:
```bash
cargo test --test tier1_feature_coverage
cargo test --test tier2_boundary_corner
cargo test --test tier3_cross_feature
cargo test --test tier4_real_world_scenarios
```

### 4.2. Run WebGL & Client-Side Tests (Node.js)
To run the automated WebGL shader, unpack precision, LRU cache, and client state test harness:
```bash
node tests/webgl/run_all.js
```

## 5. Real-World Application Scenario Details (Tier 4)

- **Scenario S1 (Extreme Convective Storm Event)**:
  - *Features Exercised*: F01, F02, F03, F08, F11, F14, F15, F16
  - *Verification*: Simulated convective cell up to 75 mm/h rain intensity with 25 m/s gale wind shift across timeline $t = -30\text{m}$ (actuals) to $t = +40\text{m}$ (forecast peak). Verified exact physical unit extractions, WebP image generation, and no panics under extreme spatial gradients.
- **Scenario S2 (Multi-Model Run Transition During Active User Scrubbing)**:
  - *Features Exercised*: F05, F07, F10, F11, F12, F15, F17
  - *Verification*: Simulated client scrubbing across 5 time indices requesting `/api/data/*` and `/api/value` while an atomic background dataset swap updates the model run version. Verified 0 request drops and immediate cache invalidation.
- **Scenario S3 (Mobile Low-Memory Device Exploration & Compare Mode)**:
  - *Features Exercised*: F09, F10, F12, F13, F14, F18
  - *Verification*: Simulated 50+ sequential dual-texture compare mode queries across Rain, Temp, Wind, and Solar. Verified bounded memory footprint and LRU eviction order.
- **Scenario S4 (Offline / Corrupted Data Network Interruption & Recovery)**:
  - *Features Exercised*: F04, F05, F06, F07, F16, F18
  - *Verification*: Ingested empty/corrupted binary forecast steps; verified graceful HTTP 200 `{ status: "no_data" }` responses and immediate recovery when valid payloads are restored.
- **Scenario S5 (High-Resolution Solar & 2m Temperature Spatial Inspection)**:
  - *Features Exercised*: F02, F07, F08, F14, F16, F17
  - *Verification*: Tested dense spatial inspection across 5 Dutch reference stations (Amsterdam, Vlissingen, Leeuwarden, Maastricht, Enschede) verifying smooth bilinear spatial gradients and physical unit realism.
